__doc__: Rows the INAO SIQO referentiel export (raw/inao/siqo-referentiel.csv) should carry and does not — read by scripts/_lib/fr/siqo.py and appended to the CSV for every FR stage. Each row uses the CSV's own 22 columns plus `_status` (`added`: a GI INAO has recognised that the export predates; `retained`: a row the export dropped that the corpus keeps — a record is never removed because an export stopped listing it; the retirement itself is recorded in cancelled_gis.json / promoted_gis.json), `_source` (the public act and the INAO product page), `_verified` (date), `_note`. Provisional ids are `p<idproduit>` (the INAO product id is public and stable); replace them with INAO's numbers when the export carries the row, keeping the slug unchanged.

rows._source: Arrêté du 11 août 2026 homologuant le cahier des charges de l'appellation d'origine protégée « Montpeyroux » (NOR AGRT2607509A, JORF 15 août 2026; https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/eli/arrete/2026/8/11/AGRT2607509A/jo/texte); INAO product page https://www2.inao.gouv.fr/produit/23354 (updated 21 September 2026); cahier BO Agri du MAASA 20 août 2026 https://info.agriculture.gouv.fr/boagri/document_administratif-2128d40f-f2c2-436a-8d1c-cd993626aa30/telechargement
rows._note: Formerly the DGC « Montpeyroux » of AOC Languedoc (SIQO id_denomination_geo 1313), dropped from the Languedoc cahier homologated the same day. National transitional protection pending the EU registration (eAmbrosia carries no application yet) — signe_ue is therefore empty, as on INAO's product page. The CVI code on the product page reads '475' and is not a complete douane code; left empty.

1091._reason: The export's `appellation` column reads 'Marc d'Alsace'; its own `produit` column, the INAO product page (idproduit 13046), the EU register (PGI-FR-01836, protectedName 'Marc d'Alsace Gewurztraminer') and the cahier des charges homologated by the arrêté du 2 septembre 2026 (section 2: « enregistrée sous la dénomination « Marc d'Alsace Gewurztraminer » au registre des Indications Géographiques ») name the GI with its mandatory dénomination. The record, its slug and its URL (/en/marc-d-alsace-gewurztraminer, live since the first build, keyed by every pin) keep the registered name; the 2026-10-01 manifest refresh re-read the column and renamed the record marc-d-alsace until this pin (2026-10-04).
